name: Ichinomiya (Chiba, Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Ichinomiya town emblem in white: an outlined ring enclosing a stylised character of loops.
history: Municipal flag of Ichinomiya, a town in Chiba Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 28 November 1973.

features.role: Ichinomiya town emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a stylised character of loops
